text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed for every step. A more advanced form, deep learning, uses complex neural networks inspired by the human brain to handle tasks like image recognition. You encounter AI every day: voice assistants on your phone, movie recommendations on streaming services, and spam filters in your email. While AI can seem futuristic, it is already quietly shaping how we work, shop, and communicate.
